seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: born x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Mechanics: single horizontal mirror axis (wall band on a 3x3 block grid), holed 3x3-block pieces, solid yellow L targets; reflections = piece blocks above the axis mirrored to block 2A-b, clipped to 21 blocks.
Selection: wall 0-dots = axis selected (A1/A2 move it +-1 block row, A3/A4 no-op); otherwise the piece with 0 hole centres moves on A1-A4; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by min block -> axis.
The hypothesis's wall 'born vs no_change' under A1 = whether the axis is selected (wall pixels show 0); 'born' is the moved axis splitting around the target above it.
Render stack piece4 > reflection3 > target2 > wall1 (holes show lower solids, else topmost fill: selected 0 / reflection 4), then re-extract: wall/player names rank 4-conn comps of own cells plus all 0 cells; targets by visible bbox. Passes 30/30, also stateless.
Unconfirmed (never observed): pieces blocked by other pieces or the board edge, pieces crossing the axis, and the A5 order after the first piece.
